title: 2-domination in the regular 4-polytopes
statement: A set D of vertices is 2-dominating when every vertex outside D has at least two neighbours in D; the 2-domination number gamma_2 is the smallest size of such a set. Determine gamma_2 for the graphs of the six regular convex 4-polytopes (the 5-cell K5; the tesseract, 16 vertices; the 16-cell, 8 vertices; the 24-cell, 24 vertices, 8-regular; the 600-cell, 120 vertices, 12-regular; the 120-cell, 600 vertices, 4-regular) and of the two E8 polytopes 3_21 (Gosset, 56 vertices, 27-regular) and 4_21 (the 240 roots of E8, 56-regular), each vertex adjacent to its nearest neighbours. First values (ours): the 5-cell 2 (exact); the tesseract (8-cell) 7 (exact); the 16-cell 2 (exact); the 24-cell 6 (exact); the 600-cell 18; the 120-cell 243; the Gosset polytope 3_21 4 (exact); the E8 root polytope 4_21 10. The headline cell is the 120-cell: find a certificate with value 242 or less (gamma_2 >= 2n/(d + 2) for a d-regular graph: >= 200 for the 120-cell), or prove 243 optimal.
submission: Text file: the vertex numbers of the set (spaces or newlines), in the checker's vertex order (the 120-cell).
score: the number of vertices in the set (smaller is better)

best_known.source: Quantavane (Arhan Canli), 10 November 2026: 243 for the 120-cell, best found: CP-SAT (one worker, 5 to 60 seconds) on the model of tools/polytope_sets.py, or, for zero forcing and power domination, greedy completion and pruning between rounds of fort cuts

context: Multiple domination (Fink and Jacobson 1985) asks for fault tolerance: every vertex left out sees two members of the set. Counting the edges between D and the rest gives 2(n - |D|) <= d |D|, so gamma_2 >= 2n/(d + 2): 18 for the 600-cell, 200 for the 120-cell, 4 for 3_21 and 9 for 4_21. For these polytope graphs nothing was found.
references: J. F. Fink, M. S. Jacobson, n-domination in graphs, in Graph Theory with Applications to Algorithms and Computer Science (Wiley 1985) 283-300
H. S. M. Coxeter, Regular Polytopes (3rd ed., Dover 1973)
the vertex numbering of checkers/orig_phys.py (polytope_graph), shared by every polytope problem of the Originals

novelty.verdict: new. No 2-domination result for the 600-cell, the 120-cell, the 24-cell or the E8 polytopes (searched with E8 and Gosset) was found on arXiv, in the journal literature (Crossref) or by web search; the known values for hypercubes and complete graphs cover only the small cells.
closest: General results on 2-domination (the references) and its values for hypercubes, grids and products; none for these polytopes.
Our polytope problems (polytope-ising, potts3-600, cell600-idcode, cell600-forest, cell120-coil, e8-idcode, e8-resolving): other invariants of the same graphs.
